spots.name: Wolf - Bordalo II
spots.blurb: You've reached Wolf - Bordalo II, a mural by Bordalo II from 2016. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Mural by Milu Correch
spots.blurb: This mural is by Milu Correch, painted in 2015. It shows O histórico mercado semanal. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
